rights_policy.rule: Public lookup pages, licensed CAP Professional records, open ANNCSU records, ISTAT boundaries, regional DBGT layers, and cadastral services remain separately governed artifacts.
rights_policy.attribution: Each published artifact must carry provider, title, edition or receipt time, license or contract reference, digest, transformation, and downstream notice.

sources.production_scope: Pinned, reviewed operator pages and query receipts used within applicable terms; not a scraped national bulk dataset.
sources.terms_note: The public service establishes current operator reference and change notices. Automated extraction, bulk caching, redistribution, and deliverability claims require separate review.

sources.production_scope: Contract-governed ingestion and validation only; public artifacts include rows or derived results only when the signed licence explicitly permits them.
sources.terms_note: CAP Professional is a commercial reference database. Product access does not imply open redistribution or permission to publish derived geometry.

sources.production_scope: Pinned national or regional monthly CSV releases and daily API receipts under CC BY 4.0 with provider attribution.
sources.terms_note: ANNCSU consultation data is CC BY 4.0. Coordinate availability and meaning must be read from the pinned schema and must not be upgraded to postal or building authority.

sources.production_scope: Pinned detailed or generalized WGS84 administrative-boundary edition under ISTAT CC BY terms with attribution.
sources.terms_note: ISTAT administrative boundaries can provide context or a derivation clip. They are not CAP boundaries and must retain the edition date and administrative level.

sources.provider: Italian regional and municipal geodata authorities
sources.production_scope: Per-dataset pinned regional or municipal DBGT layers only after metadata, coverage, scale, schema, CRS, freshness, license, attribution, and stable-link fields are reviewed.
sources.terms_note: The national DBGT specification defines a common content model; it is not a single nationwide building dataset or a uniform licence for every regional implementation.

sources.production_scope: Reference or separately rights-reviewed cadastral services; no public redistribution, automated harvesting, or address/building inference without service-specific terms and a lawful stable link.
sources.terms_note: A cadastral parcel or map feature is neither a postal assignment nor necessarily a building footprint, entrance, or deliverable address.

artifact_partitions.rule: Interactive CAP searches and change pages remain receipt evidence and never become an unlicensed bulk artifact.
CAP Professional rows, street arcs, ranges, parity, and contract metadata remain isolated according to explicit publication rights.
ANNCSU street and civic artifacts retain release, schema, stable fields, coordinate semantics, CC BY 4.0 attribution, and no postal or building authority.
ISTAT boundaries retain edition and CC BY attribution and never inherit CAP authority.
Each regional or municipal building artifact has its own coverage mask, licence, scale, freshness, identifiers, digest, and ambiguity policy.
Generated surfaces retain input artifact digests, rights proof, projection, clip, model, parameters, topology, holdout, version, and derived label.
Non-geographic fixtures only; never promotion evidence.
